why: The Grey Havens taps for {C} and, separately, for one mana of any colour AMONG LEGENDARY CREATURE CARDS IN YOUR GRAVEYARD. This deck runs six legendary creatures and can put none of them there: Zur goes to the command zone, Athreos and Heliod and Thassa are INDESTRUCTIBLE, and nothing in the 100 mills, surveils or discards. That leaves Daxos and Vito, both of which have to die and stay dead. In this deck it is a Wastes that scries 1 -- and land_colors counts it as a source of all five colours. It is a leftover from the build that ran Tymaret and The Master of Keys, both now cut. Shattered Sanctum is a real white-black source in a deck whose black is the tightest colour.

merged.forced_reason: The pilot's call. Bench deck, no paper lock, nothing physical moves. The Grey Havens makes coloured mana only from legendary creature cards in your own graveyard, and this deck can put none there — Zur goes to the command zone, three of the six are indestructible, and nothing mills or discards. Shattered Sanctum is a real white-black source: real sources W 19->20, B 27->28, gated lands 3->2, on-curve floor W +0.017 and B +0.024.
